projects.name: gipsDA R library
projects.summary: An R package for discriminant analysis classification using covariance matrices with permutation symmetries
highlights: A fully functional R library available on CRAN, developed with best programming practices
Enhances the functionality of gips by allowing estimation of permutation symmetry shared by multiple matrices
Offers functions to train Linear and Quadratic Discriminant Analysis classifiers utilizing gips methodology

projects.name: Tweet Sentiment Predictor
projects.summary: Binary sentiment classification on 100k Sentiment140 tweets via NLP feature engineering and ensemble ML
highlights: Built a three-stage Jupyter pipeline (feature engineering, selection, modeling) on a balanced 100k-tweet corpus with reproducible 5-fold cross-validation

Engineered lexical, readability, temporal, and embedding features using VADER, TextBlob, Word2Vec, Sentence-BERT (all-MiniLM-L6-v2), and spaCy; selected predictors with L1 logistic regression and feature_engine
Tuned and compared XGBoost, LightGBM, voting/stacking ensembles, and a Keras MLP with Optuna, achieving ~81% cross-validated accuracy on the extended feature set

projects.name: A Simple GPT model
highlights: Implemented a causal Transformer language model in PyTorch (attention blocks + RMSNorm)
Built a custom BPE tokenizer and corpus-to-encoding pipeline; trained on Adam Mickiewicz works and generated text via generate(...)
In progress: scaling training to the Polish Parliamentary Corpus (PPC)
